title: Check a vessel registration
summary: Check the registration details of a vessel that was previously or is currently registered in NSW.
intro: You can check a vessel’s registration details online. The free check includes:
who_can_apply: Vessels previously or currently registered in NSW

how_to_steps.text: Enter the vessel’s NSW registration number, without any spaces or dots.

more_info.text: If you intend to buy a vessel from a private seller, you should visit the Personal Property Securities Register website to find out if there is any finance owing.

external_links.text: Find a Boatcode agent – Transport for NSW

internal_links.text: Renew or restore a vessel registration
Change address and contact details (boat licence, vessel registration or other maritime licence records)

faqs.q: Who can check a vessel's registration?
faqs.a: The free check can only be run on vessels that were previously or are currently registered in NSW.

faqs.q: What information do I need to check the registration?
faqs.a: You need the vessel’s NSW registration number.

faqs.q: How do I check a vessel's registration online?
faqs.a: Select the ‘Check online’ button, enter the vessel’s NSW registration number (without spaces or dots), and select the ‘search’ icon.
